title: Design System: Nicolas Rabelo de Melo — Vault Overseer Terminal

display.purpose: Boot title, panel/dossier titles, résumé section headers. Phosphor green only.

label.purpose: Terminal-readout micro-labels: corner chrome, kickers, tag chips, button text, hotspot tags.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the dossier modal off the dimmed backdrop. Reserved for this one surface.

shadows.name: boot-title-bloom
shadows.purpose: Text-shadow bloom on the boot-screen title.

motion.name: hotspot-fade
motion.purpose: Hotspot label visibility transition as the camera/projection updates.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Flat outlined link/button used for CTAs (project links, contact links, CV download, panel close).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #9dffb0; border: 1px solid #1a8f0c; padding: 9px 14px; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: #ffb000; color: #ffb000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Inline label used for skills, certifications, and tag rows.
components.css: .ds-chip-tag { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; border: 1px solid #1a8f0c; color: #9dffb0; padding: 3px 8px; display: inline-block; }

components.name: Dossier Panel
components.description: Centered modal used for all four content sections (Projetos, Experiência, Sobre mim, Contato), opened from a hotspot click.

components.css: .ds-panel { width: min(760px, 92vw); max-height: min(78vh, 720px); overflow-y: auto; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #081209, #04080a); border: 1px solid #1a8f0c; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(57,255,20,0.08), 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); padding: 26px 28px 30px; } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1a8f0c; padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-panel-kicker { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.25em; color: #1a8f0c; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 4vw, 2.4rem); color: #39ff14; margin: 2px 0 0; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-panel-close { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #1a8f0c; color: #9dffb0; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-panel-close:hover { border-color: #ffb000; color: #ffb000; }

components.name: Hotspot Label
components.description: Screen-projected clickable marker over a 3D world object; pin dot + uppercase tag.
components.css: .ds-hotspot { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hotspot-pin { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #39ff14; box-shadow: 0 0 8px 2px rgba(57,255,20,0.8); } .ds-hotspot-tag { font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9dffb0; background: rgba(5,10,7,0.78); border: 1px solid #1a8f0c; padding: 4px 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-hotspot:hover .ds-hotspot-tag, .ds-hotspot:focus-visible .ds-hotspot-tag { border-color: #ffb000; color: #ffb000; }

components.name: Log Entry
components.description: Left-rule record block used for projects, experience, and education entries inside dossier panels.
components.css: .ds-entry { border-left: 1px solid #1a8f0c; padding-left: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; } .ds-entry-title { font-weight: 700; color: #9dffb0; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; } .ds-entry-meta { font-size: 12px; color: #ffb000; margin: 2px 0 8px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; }

narrative.overview: The build is a fixed-camera Three.js bunker room — floor stripes, rust-metal pipe conduits, a Vault-Tec stencil plaque, a vault door backdrop — rendered through a hand-rolled CRT composer (bright-pass + two-pass Gaussian blur bloom, scanline, chromatic aberration, vignette, phosphor tint) built from render targets, with no three/examples/jsm addons. The DOM overlay (boot screen, hotspot labels, dossier panels, corner chrome, and a plain-HTML résumé fallback below the stage) never pretends to be print or glass; it reads as terminal firmware laid over the 3D viewport. Phosphor green is the committed interaction color, delivered as glow/emissive/text-shadow rather than flat color fills — the room's geometry carries color and material (roughness/metalness), the UI layer carries light. This is a code-led, no-image-generation build: every token is read from src/style.css's :root custom properties and from the Three.js material/shader source, not from a visual comp.
keyCharacteristics: Phosphor-green glow as the dominant interactive signal; amber as a secondary warning/CTA accent
CRT post-process (scanline, chromatic aberration, vignette, bloom) layered over every frame, DOM included
Flat, zero-radius rectangular UI chrome; the 3D room supplies the only curved forms (dials, bezels, rivets)
Terminal mono/pixel-mono type pairing (VT323 display, Share Tech Mono body/label) with no serif, no gradient fills, no glassmorphism

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Fill Rule
rules.body: Phosphor green never appears as a flat background or solid button fill. It is always carried by emissive material, box-shadow glow, or text-shadow bloom — light, not paint.

rules.name: The All-Mono Rule
rules.body: No serif and no system UI sans anywhere in the build; every text node routes through VT323 or Share Tech Mono.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Outside the single dossier-panel modal, depth comes from phosphor/amber glow (box-shadow halos, text-shadow bloom, shader bloom), never from a generic drop-shadow card system.

dos: Do carry phosphor green as glow/emissive (text-shadow, box-shadow, material emissive), never as a flat fill — The Glow-Not-Fill Rule.
Do reserve amber strictly for hover/focus state and secondary CTA/warning emphasis; it is not a co-equal second primary.
Do keep all DOM chrome flat and zero-radius; round forms belong to hardware silhouettes in the 3D room only.
Do route every text node through VT323 (display) or Share Tech Mono (body/label) — The All-Mono Rule.
donts: Don't add a generic drop-shadow card-elevation system; depth outside the dossier modal comes from glow only.
Don't introduce new kicker/eyebrow micro-labels beyond the two inherited instances (.boot-kicker, .panel-kicker). They are a carried build detail, not a system pattern to extend onto new surfaces.
Don't add border-radius to DOM UI chrome beyond the existing circular hotspot pin.
Don't reach for the unused --danger (#ff3b30) token to invent an error/alert pattern; it is declared but not wired into any shipped component.
